question_text: A 15-year-old boy is brought to the emergency department by his parents because of lethargy, repeated vomiting, and abdominal pain for 6 hours. Over the past 2 weeks, he has reported increased urinary frequency to his parents that they attributed to his increased oral fluid intake. Examination shows dry mucous membranes and rapid, deep breathing. Laboratory studies show the presence of acetoacetate in the urine. Which of the following cells is unable to use this molecule for energy production?
